chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a man who sang every day. He sang while driving to the harbor in his car. He sang as he went up the tall hill to the harbor. Once he reached the top of the hill, he stopped his car and looked out at the harbor.

The day was bright and the water was blue. He could even see the boats in the harbor. He opened his car window and started singing his favorite song. The sound echoed over the harbor and it sounded very high.

The harbor birds joined in and flew around in the sky. They sang with the man and created a beautiful melody. The man smiled and sang louder and louder. He sang until the sun was setting behind the harbor.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a dark goat. It lived in a forest far away. One night, the dark goat went to sleep on a big, green hill.
Suddenly, a wolf came out of the shadows. He had a big sack in his mouth. The wolf growled and opened the sack. He wanted to put the dark goat in the sack.
The dark goat was so scared! He ran away as fast as he could. The wolf chased the dark goat, but the dark goat was too fast.
The dark goat ran until he reached his home. The sack was far behind. The dark goat was happy and safe!

chapters.title: JOHN was a happy boy He…
p: JOHN was a happy boy. He had a notebook and he liked to draw in it.
He was playing in the park one day, looking for something to catch. He saw a smooth stone in the grass and he ran over to pick it up.
John held the stone in his hand, it felt so smooth. He put it in his notebook.

John smiled and continued to look for something else to catch. Soon he found a pretty butterfly. He ran up and tried to catch it but it flew away. John laughed and ran around the park, looking for more things to catch.
The day ended and John went home happy. He opened up his notebook and looked at the smooth stone he had found. He was glad he could catch a piece of the park and keep it forever.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a mighty bear who believed in magic. Every night he would sit by the television and his mighty friends would come alive!

He believed that he could make anything happen if he just wished hard enough. So he wished for all his toys to come to life, and they did! One night, a tiny toy car came out of the television and it began to drive away.

The bear decided to follow it and so he went on a great adventure. He went to the far side of the world and he even flew on the back of a giant bird! Everywhere he went, he saw wonderful things and he made lots of new friends.
Though his journey lasted for only one night, the bear was so happy he believed he could fly like the other animals. He had an amazing time and he never forgot the magic he felt that night.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little puppy. Her name was Bella. Bella was very happy. She liked to play and run. Every day she would grow bigger and bigger.
One day, Bella became very ill. Her mommy worried a lot. She took Bella to the vet. There she met the veterinarian. The vet was very busy, but he was nice.
Bella saw lots of animals in the vet's office. There were cats, bunnies, and even a turtle! They were all very sick, and the vet was taking care of them.
Bella was scared, but the vet was gentle and he made her feel better. He gave her medicine and special food, and she slowly began to feel better.
The vet visited Bella a few times and each time she got healthier. Finally, she was totally better! Bella was so happy that she could run and play again.
The vet had done a great job and Bella's mom was very thankful. He had taken care of her, and Bella was able to grow up and stay happy and healthy.

chapters.title: Once there was a small girl…
p: Once there was a small girl called Lucy. She lived on a farm with her family and they loved to make jam together. Lucy always helped her family make jam and she loved it.
One day, a big storm came to the farm. It was so strong that it destroyed the jam. Lucy was very sad and she felt helpless.
But then, an idea came to Lucy. She wanted to make more jam, so she asked for help from her family. She worked really hard and eventually, she was able to make a new jar of jam.
Lucy was so happy and she had a big smile on her face. With the help of her family, she had destroyed the storm and made jam again.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a very little boy. He was out playing in the park, when he saw a bird in the mud. The bird was so sad, it was miserable. The boy wanted to help the bird, so he thought of a way to rescue it. He went over to the bird and very carefully picked it up. But he saw that the bird had a small white pill stuck in its feathers. He didn't know what to do, so he asked a grown-up. The grown-up said that if he gave the bird the pill, it would be better soon. So, the boy gave the bird the pill, and it flew away happier than ever. The boy was so pleased to have been able to rescue the bird!

chapters.title: The sky was grey and it…
p: The sky was grey and it began to rain. The raindrops were big and cold. The little girl was sad because she wanted to play outside but now it rained.
Her mom saw that she was sad and brought out a big yellow banana. The little girl smiled as she ate the banana. The sweet taste made her happy again.

But mom had a surprise too. She brought out a fake banana made of plastic. The little girl was excited to eat the fake banana. She pretended to take bites out of it and played with it for a long time.
The rain stopped and the sun came out. The little girl smiled and ran outside to play. Her fake banana stayed indoors and stayed dry.

chapters.title: Once there was a little bird…
p: Once, there was a little bird. He was so small and his wings so very tiny. He flew around, looking for something to eat.
One day, a big wind blew and made the little bird scared. He looked around for a place to keep safe. Suddenly, he saw a big tree. He quickly flew to it and nestled into its branches.
The little bird began to feel safe and snug, so he tucked his tiny wings in and went to sleep. But then, he heard a loud noise. It was a hawk, looking for something to eat!

The little bird was so frightened and didn't know what to do. He decided to hide inside the tree, deep down in a hollow branch. The hawk swooped around, looking and searching. But it couldn't find the little bird.

Suddenly, the little bird heard a noise. It was the swish of wings! Another bird had come to protect him. The big bird flew around and around, chasing away the hawk. The little bird was so thankful and happy.
The big bird had protected him and he was no longer scared. He flew away, back to the sky, feeling warm and safe.

chapters.title: Every morning Mommy would get up…
p: Every morning, Mommy would get up early and prepare breakfast for everyone. She cooked nice eggs and made toast.
But this morning was different. Mommy grabbed a special box from the cupboard and was very happy. Inside the box was a flute!
Mommy said it was a surprise and she was going to prepare a nice surprise with the flute. She began playing a song with the flute and it was so beautiful!
When Daddy and the kids woke up, they all smiled at how nice the music was. Mommy had prepared a special treat for them all. They loved it so much!

chapters.title: Once there was a girl named…
p: Once there was a girl named Lucy. She was 3 years old and loved going to the movies.
One day her mommy told her she could have an extra special treat at the movies. She was so excited.
Lucy’s mommy brought her to the ticket booth to buy a ticket. She asked for two tickets and got a nosy look from the worker behind the ticket booth.
The worker handed Lucy a ticket and told her to act grown up for the movie. Lucy took the ticket and smiled.
She and mommy went inside the theater and found two great seats. Lucy sat down and act grown up. She was very proud and excited to get to go to the movies.
Lucy sat through the entire movie without saying a word. She acted like she was a grown up. She was so proud of herself.
At the end of the movie, Lucy and her mommy held hands and walked out of the theater. Lucy was so happy she got to act grown up for her special treat.

chapters.title: Once there was a man who…
p: Once there was a man who worked in a lab. He was very busy measuring things. He had lots of warm tools: a ruler, a tape measure and a thermometer. He was measuring things both big and small. One day, he was measuring something very small and he made a discovery. It was something magical! He showed it to his friends and they were all very excited. Everyone wanted to know what it was and how he found it. He said, "I found it in the lab while measuring something small". Everyone was so happy. They had never seen anything like it before. Now, they all wanted to measure things small, to see if they could discover something magical too.

chapters.title: One day a yellow bird left…
p: One day, a yellow bird left its nest. It flew away, chirping and flapping. The bird flew over the town, and soon it found a big puddle. The puddle was sparkling in the sun.
The bird flew down and hovered over the puddle. It saw its reflection in the water, and it jumped in. The bird splashed around and had so much fun. It sang and jumped, and made a big splash.
When the bird got tired, it left the puddle. It flew up high into the sky, and went home to its nest.
The bird was tired and happy. It had a fun time in the yellow puddle.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a boy who loved to listen to the birds sing in the sky. But one day he heard something different.
It was like the sound of water pouring out of a pipe. He thought it was interesting but he couldn't figure out where it was coming from.
So he started to listen harder as he walked around his neighborhood. He looked under bushes and in the trees, but he couldn't find the sound.
Finally, he looked up in the sky and spotted it! High up in the sky was a pipe spraying water from one end. As he watched the water danced through the air.
He thought it was the most interesting thing he had ever seen. So each day he would make sure to listen for the sound of the pipe and watch the water twirl around in the sky.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl who had a big owie. She felt sad and sore, so she went to the doctor to get help. The doctor was very kind and gentle. He said that he had a special place for her to go, where she would feel more comfortable and could heal.

The little girl went to the special place and it was like a secret space. Inside, it was full of pillows, blankets and soft toys. The walls were painted with pictures of stars and she had a cozy corner with a big, comfy chair.

The little girl stayed in this special place every day. She did puzzles and played with the toys and sometimes she snuggled up in the chair with a blanket and read books. Gradually, her owie began to heal and she felt better.
The little girl was so thankful for the special space and she felt much better after her visit. She smiled and thanked the doctor for helping her to heal.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a girl named Lucy. She loved nature. Every day, she would take a thin stick and go walking in the forest.
One day, Lucy saw a bird flapping his wings in the sky. She wanted to fly like the bird, so she asked her mom for help. She requested for some wings.
Her mom smiled lovingly and told Lucy that only nature can give her wings. She said, “Look around you, Lucy! Nature has many gifts to offer.”
Lucy looked around. The trees were waving in the breeze, the little birds were chirping happily and the sun was shining brightly. Lucy smiled and said, “Yes, nature is a wonderful place!”
From that day on, Lucy would always take a thin stick and explore her beautiful nature. She knew that if she was patient, nature would reward her with the gift of wings one day.

chapters.title: One morning Jane woke up and…
p: One morning, Jane woke up and smiled. She saw a big, hairy dog running down the road. She watched it blink as it ran. Jane wanted to follow the dog, so she put on her shoes and ran after it. She called out to the dog, but it was too far away. She was about to give up, when she saw the hairy dog turn down a side street. Jane ran faster and followed the dog. When she got closer, she could see that the dog had stopped. Jane smiled and blinked. The dog was just waiting for her! She petted the dog and it licked her. Then, they both ran down the road together and played until it was time for Jane to go home. And they had the most wonderful adventure!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time there was a very lucky waffle. He lived in a big happy town and everybody loved him. He was so happy, he wanted to marry. One day he saw a beautiful waffle who also wanted to marry. So they got married right away!
The marriage made everyone in the town so excited. They all wanted to join in on the celebration! They put up decorations and made special waffles. Everybody was eating and having a good time.
The lucky waffle and his wife were so content. They both smiled and hugged each other. Everyone in the town was so happy they married.

The happy couple had a beautiful marriage. They were always together and were so in love. They were always encouraging each other. Everyone in the town was so happy for them, because they were so lucky!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a mom and her daughter. The daughter was very sweet and pretty. She loved jam. Every morning, she would help mommy spread jam on her toast.
One day, the girl wanted to make her own jam. She asked mommy to help. Together, they cut up some apples and cooked them on the stove. After awhile, the apples smelled yummy and the jam looked nice.

The girl was so excited, she wanted to give the jam to all of her friends. She put the jam in some jars, but mommy told her that she had better stay home. The girl felt a bit sad, but she knew her mom was right.

When her friends came over, the girl gave each of them a jar of her very own jam. They all said it tasted so yummy and that the girl was very clever. The girl was so proud, she danced around the room.
The jam was always a reminder of the special time that the girl and her mom shared. From then on, the girl always remained happy.

chapters.title: One day a little girl named…
p: One day, a little girl named Sarah wanted to take her puppy to the veterinarian. She promised her puppy that it was going to be fun.
The veterinarian was really nice, and he promised Sarah he would take good care of her puppy. He said it would be quick and cheap.
The veterinarian checked if her puppy was healthy. He checked all of its eyes, ears and teeth. Everything looked good.
The puppy was so happy everything was ok. Sarah promised to take better care of her pet and to take it to the veterinarian more often.
The little girl and her puppy thanked the veterinarian for being so kind and for helping her puppy, and then they both left the clinic very happy.

chapters.title: Once there was a rabbit who…
p: Once there was a rabbit who was hungry. He knew he would have to find food, so he started to look. He saw a carrot and thought it looked tasty.
He hopped over to the carrot and asked, "Can I have a bite?"
The carrot answered, "Yes, of course you can!"
The rabbit was so happy and thanked the carrot for being so kind. He took a big bite and was very satisfied.
But then he realised he had been too eager. He hadn't asked the carrot's owner for permission. The rabbit felt ashamed for not asking and ran away quickly.
The end!

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a penguin. He had a big task to do, but he was feeling very nervous. He had to pass something very important to another penguin.

The nervous penguin walked slowly and carefully. He wanted to make sure he did not trip or drop the item. He was almost at the other penguin when suddenly he heard a loud noise. He was so scared that he dropped the thing and it fell all the way down to the bottom of a deep hole!

The nervous penguin was so sad and he felt like he had failed his task. He sat down and started to cry, but then he had an idea. He waddled over to the edge of the hole and stretched his neck as far as he could. He was able to reach the thing, and he carefully passed it up to the other penguin.
The other penguin was so pleased. He thanked the nervous penguin and they both hugged. Everything was alright in the end.

chapters.title: One day a little girl named…
p: One day, a little girl named Lucy was walking through the park. She was very alert and looking around for any fun things to do. Suddenly, she saw a big tree with lots of sharp leaves. She was excited, so she started to jump around and touch the leaves. She had to be careful not to get any cuts!

After a while, Lucy decided to take a break and sat down on a park bench. Suddenly she heard a loud noise, like a beeping sound. Then she saw something she had never seen before—a big, green test! It wasn't moving, but Lucy could tell it was very important.

She walked over to it and tried to touch it, but it was too high up. She was about to walk away when something caught her eye—a button! She was so alert that she noticed it right away. She reached up and pressed it.

Suddenly, the test changed colors and made a loud noise. Lucy was so excited that she started to jump around again. She didn't know what had happened, but she was glad it worked! Then she took one more sharp look around and then ran off to find new adventures.

chapters.title: Once there was a girl named…
p: Once there was a girl named Sarah. She was three years old and loved to dance. On a sunny day, Sarah found an object that she really wanted to play with. It was big and round and blue. Sarah held it tight and started to dance. She smiled as she jumped up and down and twirled in circles. She was dancing so fast that the object flew up into the air! Sarah caught it and continued to dance. She held it tight again and moved her arms and legs up and down. She danced around the whole house, having lots of fun. Sarah was so happy that she kept on dancing until it was time for dinner.

chapters.title: Once upon a time there was…
p: Once upon a time, there was a little girl. Her name was Sally and she was three years old. One day, Sally was sitting in the kitchen. She saw something that made her very excited. It was a big pot of yellow spaghetti!
Sally smiled and asked if she could have some. Her mom said yes and put some spaghetti on a plate. Sally sat down at the table and started to eat the spaghetti. It was very good.
After she ate the spaghetti, Sally was very full. She sat down on the couch and closed her eyes. She was so happy and content.
The End.
